# AirPlay receiver dependency

The Android companion uses the GPLv3 AirPlay receiver implementation from
`io.github.jqssun:android-airplay` and its native dependencies. The Windows
receiver must use a compatible GPLv3 source implementation and publish the
corresponding source code with every distributed binary.

Do not copy Apple proprietary components or bypass protected playback. This
receiver is for ordinary Screen Mirroring content only.
